prompt:
You are scouting a single volleyball match from a fixed camera.

CRITICAL: Analyze ONLY the main court in the foreground. Ignore background matches completely.

The vertical net divides the screen into a left court and a right court. For the `side` field, output 'left' if the player making contact is physically standing on the left side of the screen, and 'right' if they are on the right side. CRITICAL: Log the side where the PLAYER is, completely ignoring where the ball is hit towards.

This clip begins at {start:.2f} seconds and runs for 6 seconds.
WARNING: Clips often start MID-RALLY. DO NOT assume the first contact is a serve just because it is early in the clip.

ONLY LOG SPECIFIC ACTIONS (SKIP THE REST):
DO NOT log every ball contact! Most contacts (regular passes, normal sets, free-ball bumps) MUST BE SKIPPED. Only output an event if it perfectly matches one of the critical actions defined below. If in doubt, SKIP IT.

ACTION DEFINITIONS:
  serve   - A hit from behind the BACK BASELINE that initiates play. Do NOT log the ball toss. Back-row hits during a live rally are attacks, NEVER serves.
  receive - A defensive pass specifically handling an opponent's serve (a ball traveling a long distance from their baseline). Do not use for passes mid-rally.
  dig     - A hard-fought defensive pass against an opponent's powerful ATTACK (a fast, downward-driven spike). Do not report easy passes.
  set     - An assist. ONLY report if it directly sets up a point-winning kill. SKIP ALL OTHER SETS.
  attack  - An offensive swing or spike intentionally directing the ball over the net.
  kill    - An attack that immediately wins the point (hits the floor or deflects wildly out). Log the ATTACK as the kill, NOT the opponent's failed dig!
  block   - A net defense. ONLY report if it immediately scores a point (a stuff block to the floor).

DEAD TIME VETO: You MUST ignore practice hits, practice serves, and post-rally bounces. Contacts after the ball hits the floor are NEVER valid. If players are standing around casually, walking, or not in a ready defensive stance, IT IS DEAD TIME. Skip all contacts.

For each contact give:
  t       - the EXACT moment of physical impact in ABSOLUTE MATCH SECONDS ({start:.2f} + offset). Estimate the offset carefully to one decimal place (e.g. 2.3). Deduplication relies on precise timing!
  type    - one of the seven above
  side    - "left" or "right" (where the player made contact)
  number  - the contacting player's jersey number as a string, or null if unreadable. Do not guess.
  error   - true if this contact was a direct error (e.g., hit into the net or out of bounds)
  point   - true ONLY for the final contact if it directly WON the point for the team that made the contact (e.g., a kill or stuff block). NEVER true for regular passes, failed digs, or errors!

Return an empty list if no valid play happens.
